messages:
carmen: Heads up — started seeing a spike in SAST failures after last night's RBAC change for the scanner service account. CI is blocking merges. Anyone else seeing KMS decrypt errors too?
sec-bot: automated alert: `sast-runner` scan_count=237 fail_rate=0.28 increased_by=+18% since 2023-11-09T23:00Z. recent_error="KMS: AccessDeniedException". link: https://ci.internal/runs/8721
ben: I saw ~20 failing PRs this morning. Most look like false positives but a few are real. KMS AccessDenied suggests the scanner SA lost decrypt on `artifact-keystore` CMK.
lila: @carmen can you paste the CI log snippet? also which RBAC change was applied?
carmen: quick log: ```2023-11-10T00:14:33Z sast-runner ERROR decrypt artifact_id=gh-12345 error=AccessDeniedException: User: serviceAccount:scanner@redwood is not authorized to use key m-arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd1234``` we rolled the change that removed an inline policy from `scanner-sa` in favor of org-level role assumption.
dmitri: That role-assume change was intended to tighten perms. Looks like the KMS key policy still references the old principal. We need to either add the new assumed-role ARN to the key policy or re-add a granting policy.
oncall-sre: CI is noisy and blocking merges. Can we open a temporary CI waiver for `sast-runner` while we triage? We should avoid disabling the scan entirely.
alice: Two parallel actions: 1) emergency CI waiver for flakiness to let merges through (non-blocking), 2) fix KMS key policy + add audit log for KMS:Decrypt failures. Also we should document this scenario in the scan-oncall runbook.
ben: For quick mitigation, add `kms:Decrypt` for the assumed role principal to the key policy. I'll draft the key policy increment. Who has key-policy perms?
lila: I can do the key policy edit in staging and test. Need exact ARN for the assumed role — it's `arn:aws:sts::111111111:assumed-role/infra-scan-role/scanner`.
carmen: confirm that ARN — that's what was deployed in the role-binding change.
dmitri: After key policy fix, we should re-run a subset of failing jobs to confirm. Also tune scanner heuristics: a lot of hits look like generated code patterns from the new lint rule. We should reduce severity for that heuristic and add a signature whitelist for our proto-generated clients.
oncall-sre: Action items: - apply temporary CI waiver (alice) - patch key policy in staging (lila) - add KMS decrypt audit alert to sec-alerts (dmitri) - create lightweight CT ticket for scanner heuristic tuning and whitelist (ben) - update oncall runbook with RBAC->KMS mapping and rollback steps (carmen)
sec-bot: created alert: KMS-decrypt-failures-high -> channel=eng-security severity=warning link: https://alerts.internal/alerts/9876
ben: Heuristic tuning idea: downgrade rule `proto-assertions` from error->warning and add a fuzzy suppression for `gen_client.go` files. We already do this in one repo, replicate pattern. I'll open PR with example config.
lila: Staging key policy patch applied, tested decrypt with a small job: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://c.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd1234 --profile staging-scanner` succeeded.
carmen: re-ran three failing PRs in staging, they now pass decrypt but a couple SAST findings remain for the proto client — looks like false positives from the rule char-seq.
dmitri: Good. Next: add a fine-grained KMS audit: CloudTrail filter for `kms:Decrypt` failures and a Lambda to annotate CI run with cause when we see AccessDenied. That will save us time next time.
oncall-sre: CI waiver is live as a soft-fail flag for `sast-runner` for the next 2 hours. Please keep rolling with caution.
alice: I'll update the oncall runbook: include checklist "If scanner SA role was changed -> check KMS key policy and CloudTrail for Decrypt failures -> patch key->re-run subset -> if still failing, escalate to infra oncall". Will add example commands and exact IAM ARNs.
ben: Opened PR for heuristic config: https://git.internal/repo/sast-config/pull/45 (notes: proto file whitelist + severity adjust + test suite).
carmen: I'll own the runbook update and filing the postmortem note. Adding timeline + root cause: RBAC change -> mismatch with key policy referencing old principal -> decrypt failures -> spike in SAST fail rate -> pipeline block.
dmitri: Also recommend we add an automated preflight check in the RBAC change template: when role principal changes, check any KMS keys where the old principal is referenced. We can script a check in the infra PR CI.
lila: Agreed. I'll add a preflight script to infra repo and a CHAPTER in the runbook about key-policy drift.
oncall-sre: Thanks everyone, CI is back to soft-fail mode until fixes land. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: incident-note created: "sast spike - kms key policy mismatch" id=INC-20231110-01 link: https://inc.internal/INC-20231110-01
carmen: will follow up with a short postmortem and actions. Thanks for quick responses.
